item.title: [+1] September exports jump 23% to $44.4 billion; goods trade deficit at $30.21 billion
item.description:
Imports rose to $74.61 billion. The deficit narrowed from $33 billion a year ago but widened from $26.86 billion in August, in line with the $30.4 billion forecast. With services, the deficit was $13.3 billion. Exports rose 18.5% in April–September.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild tailwind (+1) — Chemical exports rise

Why it matters: Strong exports of electronics, engineering goods, petroleum products and chemicals support growth and dollar inflows, but oil-driven imports keep the deficit high and the rupee under pressure.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months
